crossRefs.note: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from…
To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city

translations.web: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
translations.bsb: So to this day Edom has been in rebellion against the hand of Judah. Likewise, Libnah rebelled at the same time.
translations.kjv: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
translations.asv: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then did Libnah revolt at the same time.
